items.title: No compact-open type-zero parahoric topology for split Kac–Moody groups with infinite Weyl group over non-Archimedean local fields
items.author: Ramla Abdellatif; Auguste Hébert
items.source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 6 (2019), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.88
items.difficulty_reason: Full authored retraction uniqueness and half-apartment fixer argument under the precise masure assumptions identify point/wall/chamber orbits. All three checks of the wall-to-chamber bijection and the alternating finite-thickness factors yield unbounded orbits from infinitely many positive real roots. This multi-step new local orbit-growth construction, followed by the finite-index compactness contradiction, meets H2; the final contradiction alone is not the selected proof and no helper is counted.
